auc.inputs_code:
# Quantized scores: heavy ties on purpose — position-based ranks
# cannot match the tie-averaged reference.
scores = np.round(rng.random(80), 1)
y = (rng.random(80) < 0.55).astype(float)
inputs = (y, scores)

fit-gd.inputs_code:
X = rng.normal(size=(80, 3))
w_true = np.array([2.0, -1.0, 0.5])
y = (rng.random(80) < 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-(X @ w_true)))).astype(float)
inputs = (X, y, 0.5, 250)

log-loss.inputs_code:
# Rows scaled 20x push |logits| past 300: a log-loss written as
# log(sigmoid) instead of logaddexp goes non-finite here and can
# never match the expected value.
X = rng.normal(size=(60, 5))
X[:12] *= 20.0
w = rng.normal(0.0, 4.0, size=5)
b = 0.5
y = (rng.random(60) > 0.4).astype(float)
inputs = (w, b, X, y)

newton.inputs_code:

w_true = np.array([1.2, -0.8, 0.4])

inputs = (X, y, 8)
